videos.script: Which days had heavy rain? Not how many. Which. {{which}} In NumPy, that question is an array of true and false, the same length as the data. A mask. {{mask}} Index with it, and you keep the days where it says true. Index the dates with the same mask, and you get their dates. {{dates}} Two conditions together need an ampersand, not the word and. Each in its own brackets. {{combine}} Get either wrong and NumPy stops you, with a message worth reading once. {{error}} Then there is the mistake that does not stop you. Select with a mask, then assign to part of the result. {{trap}} It reads like a change. It changes a copy, and the copy is thrown away. {{copy}} Index once, on the left of the equals sign. Lesson eleven meets the same trap in pandas. {{end}}
